entities.summary: Scott William Arniel is a Canadian professional ice hockey coach and former player who is the head coach for the Winnipeg Jets of the National Hockey League (NHL). Previously, he was the head coach of the Columbus Blue Jackets and associate coach of the New York Rangers, Washington Capitals and Winnipeg Jets. As a player, he played as left winger for the original Jets franchise, as well as the Buffalo Sabres and Boston Bruins.
